extDescription.message: Hide, collapse, minimize, or blur Google's AI Overview, AI Mode, and Gemini prompts.
extDescription.description: Extension description shown in the store and on the extensions page (max 132 characters).

barCollapsed.message: AI Overview hidden. Click to expand.

barExpanded.message: AI Overview shown. Click to collapse.
barExpanded.description: Collapsed bar label while the block is expanded.

showMore.description: Button under a minimized AI Overview.

showLess.description: Button under an expanded, previously minimized AI Overview.

revealBlurred.description: Overlay button on a blurred AI Overview.

optOverviewMode.description: Label of the AI Overview mode picker.

modeShow.description: AI Overview mode: leave as is.

modeCollapse.description: AI Overview mode: slim bar that expands on click.

modeMinimize.description: AI Overview mode: short preview with a Show more button.

modeBlur.description: AI Overview mode: blurred until revealed.

optHideAiMode.message: Hide AI Mode buttons and tabs

optWebOnly.message: Web only results (no AI at all)
optWebOnly.description: Toggle label for the udm=14 redirect.

optWebOnlyHelp.message: Redirects searches to Google's plain Web results, which have no AI Overview. Images, News and other tabs are left alone.
optWebOnlyHelp.description: Help text under the Web only toggle.

btnRevealPage.description: Popup button that temporarily reveals blocks in the current tab.

btnRehidePage.description: Popup button that re-applies the configured modes in the current tab.

statusNotGoogle.message: Open a Google search page to see Gemino at work.
statusNotGoogle.description: Popup status line when the active tab is not a supported page.

linkOptions.description: Popup link to the options page.

optDebug.message: Debug: outline detected blocks (and show them)

optShortcutHelp.message: Default: Alt+Shift+G turns Gemino on or off. Open your browser's extension shortcuts page to change it.
optShortcutHelp.description: Help text next to the shortcut link.

scopeNote.message: Gemino cannot change the browser's own Gemini or AI buttons (such as Chrome's Gemini button or Opera's Aria); those are part of the browser itself.
scopeNote.description: Scope disclaimer on the options page.
